{
  "dataset_name": "compass",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "total_juv_offenses",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all juvenile offenses including felonies, misdemeanors, and other charges.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 33.0],
      "feature_family": "criminal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous severity measure of juvenile criminal history, which is useful for establishing linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "juv_fel_count + juv_misd_count + juv_other_count"
    },
    {
      "name": "priors_per_year_adult",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Rate of prior offenses per year of adulthood (age minus 17).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 43.0],
      "feature_family": "criminal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes prior counts by exposure time, creating a smooth rate feature that linear models can weight effectively.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "priors_count / (age - 17.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_priors_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed count of prior offenses to compress the long tail.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "criminal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in prior counts, improving the stability of the linear SVM decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(priors_count)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_severity_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between youthfulness (years under 50) and the log of prior offenses.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 150.0],
      "feature_family": "demographic_history_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Explicitly provides the linear model with a non-linear interaction term combining age risk and criminal history.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(0.0, 50.0 - age) * np.log1p(priors_count)"
    },
    {
      "name": "recent_criminal_activity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assess the recency and intensity of criminal activity based on days_b_screening_arrest, c_days_from_compas, and priors_count.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures semantic nuances of how recent arrests and screenings correlate with ongoing risk, providing a continuous severity score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "is_young_with_priors",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for individuals under 25 who already have at least one prior offense.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demographic_history_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a sharp linear projection for a specific high-risk demographic subgroup.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((age < 25) & (priors_count > 0), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "weighted_criminal_history",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of criminal history, assigning higher weights to felonies and adult priors.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 150.0],
      "feature_family": "criminal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Pre-computes a domain-informed severity score, allowing the SVM to use a single strong continuous feature for criminal past.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "juv_fel_count * 3.0 + juv_misd_count * 1.5 + juv_other_count * 1.0 + priors_count * 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "days_b_screening_arrest_abs_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed absolute days between screening and arrest.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses the wide variance in screening-to-arrest times into a smooth, normalized scale suitable for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.abs(days_b_screening_arrest))"
    },
    {
      "name": "c_days_from_compas_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed days from COMPAS assessment to current charge.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skewness in the temporal gap feature, preventing large values from dominating the SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(c_days_from_compas)"
    },
    {
      "name": "charge_severity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Evaluate the severity of the current charge based on c_charge_degree and its context.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "current_offense",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates categorical charge degrees into a continuous, ordinal severity measure that a linear model can easily weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "risk_score_composite",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A composite risk assessment based on decile_score.1, score_text, v_decile_score, and v_score_text.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "baseline_scores",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates multiple baseline categorical risk assessments into a single continuous probability-like score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "priors_to_age_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of prior offenses to total age.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "criminal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an alternative normalized rate of offending that scales smoothly across the entire age range.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "priors_count / age"
    }
  ]
}
